name: cloudfault
description: Systematic resilience and distributed-correctness testing for Cloudflare Workers and external APIs.

scripts.clean: find packages -type d -name dist -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && find packages -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -delete
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -b packages/core packages/adapter-sdk packages/cloudflare packages/stripe packages/adapters packages/fast-check
scripts.test:workers: vitest run --config examples/workflow-vitest/vitest.config.js && vitest run --config examples/durable-object-vitest/vitest.config.js && vitest run --config examples/outbound-stripe-vitest/vitest.config.js && vitest run --config examples/storage-vitest/vitest.config.js
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:workers
scripts.demo: npm run build && node packages/cli/bin/cloudfault-v2.mjs demo
scripts.inspect: npm run build && node packages/cli/bin/cloudfault-v2.mjs inspect
